intro.heading: ONE NIGHT IN THE OLD HOUSE
lines: Wren cannot sleep. The house creaks, and the candle on the floor is almost new.
He has four patchwork dolls, sewn from old coats and buttons. Tonight they are not only toys.
He holds their strings and sends them down, room by room, toward the thing that lives deepest in the house.

doll_lost: Wren: "No... %s, come back. I can sew you, I promise."
Wren holds a string with nothing on the end of it. %s is gone.
mimic: Wren only has four dolls. He counts the strings again. Five follow.

mimic_eyes.glass: Glass eyes: the extra doll's seams do not join. Wren never sewed that one.
mimic_eyes.ears: Stitched ears: the loose-seamed doll is breathing. Wren's dolls do not breathe.
